annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect they're leaning on me because they don't feel they have the facts

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The organizer probably believes I'm neutral since my payment's settled

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I wonder if they assumed one thank-you was all they'd planned for

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The organizer likely wants a quick, trusted answer
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because they only saw the finished event, not who did what

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The organizer seems to think my view is unbiased
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: unbiased because nothing changes for me either way

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the organizer might suspect any yes from me is loyalty talking
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Since the coworker and I are friends, the organizer might suspect

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: suggests they expect total candor and maybe don't want this discussed openly

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: If the organizer thinks it rewards the late hours
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: they'd presumably see both of us the same way, since we put in identical time

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The organizer seems to trust my judgment enough to follow it
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: probably because I was right there and they weren't
